outline:
本課程針對職業教育與訓練做整體性介紹: 1.使學生瞭解我國技職教育重要政策與特色。 2.使學生認識我國技職教育之設置群科。 3.建立學生從事技職教育教學之基礎。
本課程擬培養之教師專業素養指標： 1-3了解我國教育政策、法規及學校實務，以作為教育實踐基礎。

This course offers an introduction about vocational education and training as following (a) flexible adjustment the system of vocational education and training in Taiwan (b) emphasizing vocation education and training system; (c) establish solid theoretical foundation of the vocational education and training.
